subject: new error for models that previously converged without errors

messages.author: ff0dbee5d90b10c1
messages.subject: new error for models that previously converged without errors
parts:
So I have been running some models in Lavaan which worked fine, but now I get the following warning: in cbind(c1, c2, c3, deparse.level = 0) : number of rows of result is not a multiple of vector length (arg 3)

the occur only when I regress a binary variable on a latent variable like so: latent_variable ~ binary_variable 

I wonder if it just me who have messed something up from before or if this could be an warning due to an update of R of Lavaan. has anybody experienced something similar?

best

Martin
